limitations: This is a bounded projection of one existing web-mode command, not a complete browser model or a proof of implementation refinement.

One selected element, one command, one loaded loopback page and at most one HTTP effect after the initial load. The implementation hook checks real GET/POST requests, payload, tab URL and disabled errors in the existing fixture.

The transport and tab/history owners are abstracted at command completion. HTTP completion, policy allow and absence of concurrent commands are assumptions; transport failure, cancellation, restart, cross-tab races, native profiles and policy decisions remain outside this model.
The change does not add persistence or retry state. Existing URL and effect policy checks remain in browser-workspace-forms.ts; separate policy integration checks are still required.
Arbitrary DOM structures, event handlers, invalid nested interactive elements and text-input implicit submission are not enumerated by these finite fixture cases.
